node.statement: Direct block multiplication gives X_r X_c=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). The amplified compressed-product identification in the validated rectangular-product lemma gives X_r dot X_c=Co_{Q_n,Q_n}(X_rX_c)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(X^dagger X)=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X). Thus both the ambient and compressed products are precisely the square zero-paddings of the original row-column products; in particular the latter lands in the Q-corner, and ||X_r dot X_c-X_rX_c||=||X^dagger dot X-X^dagger X||.
